journal.day.title: {weekday} {day} {month}
journal.side.reflectionMeta: {time}, from {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} you kept
journal.first.title: Your journal
journal.first.body: Write about your day here, in words, voice or photos. Everything you keep during the day lands on the timeline below, so it is already half written. It is kept on this computer. A phone you added can read it too.
journal.notReady.title: Nocturne is getting ready.
journal.notReady.body: What you keep is safe and will be read when it is.
journal.entry.placeholder: Write about today, or hold Space to talk.
journal.entry.reading: Nocturne will read this when you stop writing for a while.
journal.timeline.heading: Through the day
journal.timeline.leftOut: Left out. It stays in your journal.
journal.timeline.empty: Nothing kept today yet. Anything you keep, from here, the keep bar or your phone, shows up here.
journal.timeline.error: Nocturne couldn’t get this day. What you kept is safe.
journal.quick.label: How does it feel? (optional)
journal.quick.keptWith: Kept, with {word}. It’s on today’s journal.
journal.checkin.title: How are you feeling?
journal.checkin.lead: Pick a spot, then the words that fit. There are no wrong answers.
journal.checkin.showList: Show all words as a list
journal.checkin.urge: Did you feel like doing anything? (optional)
journal.help.title: Something that might help
journal.help.lead: Some ideas people find useful. Try one if you like.
journal.help.idea.move.walk: Walk to the end of the road and back.
journal.help.idea.move.shake: Shake out your hands and shoulders for a minute.
journal.help.idea.slow.breathe: Breathe out for longer than you breathe in, five times.
journal.help.idea.slow.name: Name five things you can see.
journal.help.idea.think.write: Write the worry down, then write what you would tell a friend.
journal.help.idea.think.week: Ask: will this matter in a week?
journal.help.idea.reach.message: Send a message to someone you like.
journal.help.idea.reach.tell: Tell someone how today is going.
journal.help.safety: If you feel unsafe, or might hurt yourself, call your local emergency number or someone you trust now.
journal.people.rolePlaceholder: For example, a friend from climbing
journal.people.knownMeta: {role} · {count, plural, one {# memory} other {# memories}} from this entry
journal.people.removed: Removed {name} from this entry. What it said about {kind, select, person {them} other {it}} is let go, not deleted.
journal.people.refile: Choose who or what this belongs to instead of {subject}. Only the memories from this entry move, and their words stay as they are.
journal.reflection.feltEmpty: You didn’t say how today felt.
journal.reflection.footer.onDemand: Written on this computer at {time}, from {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} you kept.
journal.reflection.footer.overnight: Written overnight on this computer, from {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} you kept that day.
journal.reflection.deleted: Deleted. Your entries are untouched. You can write it again.
journal.reflection.writing.title: Looking back on your day…
journal.reflection.writing.body: This can take a minute on this computer.
journal.reflection.partial: {count, plural, one {# thing from today is} other {# things from today are}} still being read, so {count, plural, one {it isn’t} other {they aren’t}} in this yet.
journal.reflection.partialAction: Write it again when {count, plural, one {it’s} other {they’re}} read
journal.reflection.nothing: Nothing to look back on yet. Keep something about today, and come back.
journal.reflection.glance.notReady: Nocturne can write about this day once it is ready. Until then, here is the day at a glance.
journal.reflection.glance.notOnThisCompu: On this computer, Nocturne lists the day rather than writing about it.
journal.reflection.removed: One line was taken out because what it came from was deleted.
journal.reflection.failed: Nocturne couldn’t write this just now. Your entries are safe.
journal.glance.heading: At a glance
journal.glance.kept: {count, plural, one {# thing} other {# things}} kept: {kinds}.

journal.recap.onDemand.year: Look back on this year so far

journal.recap.nothing: Nothing to look back on here.
journal.recap.empty.week: No weeks to look back on yet.
journal.recap.empty.month: No months to look back on yet.
journal.recap.empty.year: No years to look back on yet.

journal.reminder.label: Evening reminder
journal.reminder.hint: A quiet nudge at a time you choose. It says nothing about your journal.
journal.a11y.field: How you feel, by energy and how pleasant it is
journal.a11y.fieldHelp: Use the arrow keys to move the point.
journal.online.step5.neverSent: Your reflections and recaps. They are written on this computer and stay here.

journal.online.settings.hint: A line from an entry, a check-in or a good thing may go with a question it helps answer. They can’t be marked private. Reflections and recaps never go.
journal.online.settings.value: Entries, check-ins and good things, when they help
